source.headline: Simulated statistics office publishes its quarterly survey
source.text:
October 13, 2026

Simulated statistics office publishes its quarterly survey

The Simulated Statistics Office reported that output in the surveyed sector rose 1.2 percent in the third quarter, after a 0.4 percent decline in the second quarter.

The office said it expects to revise the estimate when late responses arrive. The office’s next survey is scheduled for January.

SYNTHETIC TEST SOURCE: invented for the user-contract fixtures.
